comparisons.peer_topic: Asset and Wealth Management services overview
comparisons.peer_summary: The Asset & Wealth Management segment provides investment services to institutional and individual clients globally, managing assets across equity, fixed income, and alternative investments through various structures like mutual funds and separately managed accounts.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures describe AUM or asset management business classifications and structures, but differ in the nature of the change. Morgan Stanley (MS) explicitly details a reclassification of $6 billion in AUM from Fixed Income to Alternatives and Solutions due to a business combination with Parametric. Goldman Sachs (GS) provides a static overview of its Asset & Wealth Management segment, noting it manages assets across equity, fixed income, and alternative investments through various structures, but does not report a specific dollar-volume reclassification event or structural business merger affecting AUM categorization in the same manner as MS.

sentences.text: 5.In 2023, our Retail Municipal and Corporate Fixed Income business ("FIMS") was combined with our Parametric retail customized solutions business.
The impact of the change was a $6 billion movement in AUM from Fixed Income to the Alternatives and Solutions asset class included in Other.
We manage client assets across a broad range of investment strategies and asset classes, including equity, fixed income and alternative investments.
We offer our investment solutions in a variety of structures, including separately managed accounts, mutual funds, private partnerships and other commingled vehicles.

comparisons.peer_topic: Reclassification of net funding costs in Equity Markets
comparisons.peer_summary: In Q4 2024, certain net funding costs previously allocated to Fixed Income Markets were reclassified to Equity Markets, with prior-period amounts revised to conform.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures involve internal reclassifications or reallocations within financial business lines, but they concern different financial measures and scopes. MS reports a $6 billion movement in Assets Under Management (AUM) balances between asset classes (Fixed Income to Alternatives) due to a structural business combination. JPMorgan reports a reclassification of net funding costs from Fixed Income Markets to Equity Markets for accounting presentation purposes, which is an expense allocation change rather than a change in asset classification or business structure.
